methods_and_limits: Exact owner path, non-null frozen owner before hash, primary identifier and normalized preferred label; additional normalized descriptive token overlap is a candidate generator, never identity proof. All selected exact payload bytes verified against their index hashes.

All nine other local branch trees and selected index payloads were inspected from committed git objects. gitignore cannot hide a committed tree entry. This is not a search of uncommitted/ignored working state and does not claim absent uncommitted proposals.

Worker01 uses shard/proposals.json. Worker07 explicitly selects the issue1203 successor full index; its root index is superseded for those replacements. Worker09 hexahydrate followup contains no new proposal payloads.

This inventory does not establish other-worker scientific correctness, winner selection, global synonym scope, complete owner equivalence or mapping release. The coordinator retains every originating case link when reconciling duplicates.
W08 inorganic proposals-v4 is the observed current input. A later molybdate correction must be rebound; unchanged owner path or identifier alone does not transfer payload approval.
Potential dependencies from broad component/label similarity are candidate leads. Rejected hydrate-token and shared-pointer-number hits remain recorded to expose false-positive search behavior.
